title: Production of CRISPRi-engineered primary human mammary epithelial cells with baboon envelope pseudotyped lentiviral vectors
protocol: Rapidly thaw cryopreserved HEK293T cells by gently swirling the vial in a 37°C water bath until there is just a small bit of ice left in the vial.
Transfer the cell suspension to a 15 mL conical tube containing 9 mL pre-warmed HEK cell culture medium and centrifuge at 200 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant and gently resuspend the cell pellets into pre-warmed HEK cell culture medium.
Count HEK293T cells using a Malassez counting chamber.
Seed 1.2 × 10^6 cells in a 100 mm culture dish supplemented with 10 mL HEK cell culture medium containing geneticin (200 μg/mL).
Incubate cell culture in a humidified incubator at 37°C containing 5% CO2 in air.
Split 70–80% confluent cultures 1:4 to 1:10 for expansion.
Coat 100 mm culture dish with 2 ml of aseptic Poly-L-Lysine solution (0.01%) by gently swirling.
Leave coated plate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Remove excess Poly-L-Lysine solution from the plate.
Thoroughly rinse the surface with sterile water at room temperature.
Aspirate without allowing the surface to dry.
Coat a 100 mm plate with Poly-L-Lysine to promote cell adhesion.
Plate 3–4×10^6 HEK293T cells on the coated plate in 7 mL of pre-warmed culture medium.
Gently swirl the plate to ensure uniform seeding of cells.
Incubate the cells at 37°C.
Check the plates after 18–24 hours for confluence, aiming for approximately 70–80%.
Do not use cells at 90% confluency or more for transfection.
Prepare transfection mixtures in 15 mL conical polypropylene tubes suitable for one 100 mm plate, scaling up as needed.
Add and carefully mix the plasmids DNA in 3 mL of pre-warmed Opti-MEM I Reduced Serum Medium.
Use a maximal quantity of 15 μg of DNA.
Mix DNA plasmids with Lipofectamine PLUS Reagent at a ratio of 35.5/29/35.5 for the specified plasmids.
Add 15 μL of Lipofectamine PLUS Reagent directly to the DNA mix and mix gently.
Incubate the mixture at room temperature (RT) for 15 minutes.
Add 37.5 μL of Lipofectamine LTX to the mixture, mix by gentle swirling or inverting.
Incubate the final mixture at RT for 25 minutes.
Transfect cells by adding 3 mL of DNA-lipid mixtures dropwise to a 100 mm plate.
Gently swirl the plate.
Incubate at 37°C for 4–6 hours.
Aspirate the media from the culture dish.
Replace with 10 mL of pre-warmed Opti-MEM-1% HEPES.
Incubate at 37°C for 48 hours.
Check expression of the fluorescent reporter protein using a fluorescence microscope.
Harvest viral supernatants from vector-producing cells after 48 hours.
Centrifuge (500 g, 10 minutes, room temperature) to remove cells and debris.
Filter through a 0.45 μm syringe filter using cellulose acetate or polyethersulfone filters.
Concentrate clarified lentiviral vector supernatant by adding 1 volume of Lenti-X Concentrator to 3 volumes of clarified viral supernatant.
Mix by gentle inversion and incubate mixture at 4°C for 30 min to 16 hours.
Centrifuge sample at 1,500 g for 45 minutes at 4°C after incubation.
Gently aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the off-white pellet in 1% of the original volume using Opti-MEM-1% HEPES or medium adapted for transduction of target cells.
Let the sample sit for a few minutes with the resuspended solution.
Gently swirl or pipette up and down to ensure complete suspension.
Avoid fast and harsh pipetting; do not vortex.
Titrate the sample immediately or store aliquots at -80°C until use.
Count untransfected HEK293T cells using Malassez counting chamber.
Seed 0.2 × 10^6 HEK293T cells/well in a 6-well plate and supplement with pre-warmed HEK cell culture medium to reach 2 mL final volume.
Gently swirl the plate so that cells are uniformly seeded.
Incubate 16 h at 37°C.
Aspirate the plating medium without disturbing the cells.
Replace it with 2 mL of pre-warmed HEK cell culture medium.
Prepare a stock solution of LV by adding 10 μL of concentrated lentiviral vector to 990 μL of HEK cell culture medium in a 1.5 mL tube.
Perform serial dilutions of the viral sample in 1.5 mL tubes for transduction.
Seed one well with non-transduced control cells and another well to count cells at the time of transduction.
Add the mixtures (tubes 1–6) dropwise to each of the seeding wells step #23 (wells 1–6).
Complete with protamine sulfate to a final concentration of 10 μg/mL.
Gently swirl the plate to ensure homogeneous distribution.
Centrifuge the plate at 1,000 g for 90 min at room temperature without braking phase.
Count the number of non-transduced seeded cells in the control plate step #23.
Place the plate in the incubator at 37°C and check the percentage of positive cells after 3 days.
Aspirate the medium from the wells at 3 days post-transduction.
Gently wash the cells with 1 mL of DPBS (1X) to avoid detachment.
Detach adherent cells by adding 0.5 mL of Trypsin-EDTA (0.25%) solution per well.
Incubate for 3 min at 37°C.
Add 2 mL of HEK cell culture medium to each well to neutralize the Trypsin.
Collect cells from each well in a 15 mL tube and centrifuge at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Remove the medium and wash the cells with 10 mL DPBS (1X).
Centrifuge again at 500 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Discard the supernatant and stain the cells for 10–15 min at room temperature with the viability dye diluted 1:1,000 in DPBS (1X).
Wash the cells with DPBS (1X).
Centrifuge the cells at 500 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Remove the supernatant and resuspend the cell pellet in 500 μL of DPBS (1X)-2% Formaldehyde.
Transfer the cell suspension into FACS tubes.
Wear sterile gloves over cut-proof gloves.
Divide breast tissue sample into large pieces (≈100 × 50 mm).
Tape a dish with a diameter of 150 mm to the hood workbench.
Transfer each large tissue piece to an individual taped dish.
Use two scalpels for mechanical dissociation to obtain small tissue pieces of 1-2 mm in diameter.
Change scalpels between dishes during mechanical dissociation.
Perform mechanical dissociation until tissue pieces are reduced to desired size, not exceeding 3 hours total.
Transfer dissociated tissue into a sterile 2 L trypsinizing flask using a sterile funnel.
Add collagenase III dissociation medium to the flask, diluting it in DMEM/F12 (1:1) solution according to the proportion of fatty tissue.
Cover the neck of the flask with sterile aluminum foil and seal it with parafilm.
Place the flask in a 2D orbital Incu-shaker at 37°C and 130 rpm for 16 hours.
Prepare retronectin coated plate for an incubation period of 12–16 hours at 4°C, or coat retronectin at 37°C for 2 hours in the incubator.
Allow the flask to stand on the bench for about 10 minutes after 16 hours of collagenase III dissociation.
Drain off the fat layer from the trypsinizing flask.
Collect the stroma and organoid-enriched layers.
Keep the flask at room temperature to avoid fat solidification during enzymatic digestion.
Drain the fat layer downwards into a container by tipping the flask.
Transfer the remaining liquid (stroma layer + organoids-enriched layer) to a 500 mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the 500 mL tube at 50 g for 30 seconds at room temperature.
Drain the stroma layer downwards into a container by tipping the 500 mL tube.
Transfer all remaining liquid in a 50 mL conical tube.
Centrifuge the 50 mL conical tubes at 80 g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Allow the remaining liquid to drain downwards carefully retaining the organoid-enriched pellet.
Resuspend each organoid-enriched pellet in 10 ml of DPBS (1X)-5% FBS.
Pool organoid-enriched suspension in a new 50 mL conical tube containing four pellets per tube.
Check organoids size and integrity using an inverted phase microscope by transferring a fraction of the organoid-enriched suspension to a well of a 24-well plate.
Add 25 μl of Trypan blue to the suspension for improved analysis of organoid integrity.
Aspirate completely the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add 5–10 mL (depending on the size of pellets) of pre-warmed dispase to the pellet.
Incubate the mixture pellet/dispase at 37°C in a 2D orbital Incu-shaker for 2–3 min (130 rpm).
Pour the mixture through a 40 μm cell strainer placed at the top of a 50 mL conical tube to separate single cells from undigested organoids.
Rinse the cell strainer with 10 mL of DPBS (1X).
Transfer remaining organoids on the cell strainer with disposable sterile forceps into a new 50 mL conical tube.
Repeat steps #55 to #57.
Check single cell suspension quality using an inverted phase microscope by mixing 10 μL of the suspension with 10 μL of Trypan blue in a Malassez counting chamber.
If only single cells are observed, stop the dissociation process and proceed from step #64.
If partially digested organoids are still present, continue to steps #59 to #63.
Centrifuge 50 mL conical tubes at 100 g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate completely the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add 2–3 mL of pre-warmed Trypsin-EDTA (0.25%) on the pellet and incubate at 37°C in a 2D orbital Incu-shaker for 2–3 minutes at 130 rpm.
Add 5 mL of DPBS (1X)-5% FBS and pour the digested organoids through a cell strainer 40 μm placed at the top of a new 50 mL conical tube.
Proceed to cell counting using a Malassez counting chamber.
Discard the container filled with fat and stroma layer in an infectious clinical waste bin.
Seal the lid with parafilm to avoid leakage.
Pre-warm the centrifuge at 37°C for all steps.
Add 500 μL of retronectin (40 μg/mL) in each well of a 24-well plate.
Incubate the plate at 4°C for 12h–16h.
Alternatively, retronectin coating can be done in the incubator at 37°C for 2h.
Collect retronectin from 24-well plate and store at −20°C.
Rinse coated wells with DPBS (1X).
Defrost the lentiviral vector on ice.
Mix both KRAB (mCherry) and sgRNA (BFP) lentiviral vectors at MOI equal to 2 in 250 μL of MEBM mammosphere medium.
Centrifuge 24-well plates at 1,000 g for 3 hours at 37°C without braking phase.
Resuspend pHMECs at a concentration of 1 × 10^6 cells/mL in MEBM mammosphere medium supplemented with protamine sulfate (10 μg/ml).
Add 250 μL of the cell suspension per well.
Centrifuge at 1,000 g for 16 hours at 37°C without braking phase.
Transfer non-adherent transduced cells from 24-well plate into 15 mL conical tube (2 mL/tube, i.e., a pool of 4 wells).
Rinse wells with 500 μL of DPBS (1X).
Transfer the washing solution to the corresponding 15 mL conical tube containing previously harvested non-adherent infected cells.
Add 250 μL of Trypsin-EDTA (0.05%) to each well for adherent cell harvesting.
Incubate the 24-well plate at 37°C in a cell culture incubator for 3 min.
Harvest cells by flushing the wells and transfer the cell suspension to the corresponding 15 mL conical tube.
Rinse wells with 500 μL of DPBS (1X) and transfer washing solution to the corresponding 15 mL conical tube if some cells are still adherent.
Centrifuge 15 mL conical tubes at 100 g for 5 min at room temperature.
Aspirate completely the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in 2 mL of fresh MEBM mammosphere medium.
Transfer each 15 mL conical tube to one well of an Ultra-low Attachment 6-well plate.
Maintain cells in culture incubator for 5 days to allow expression of lentiviral vectors.
Supplement each well every 2 days with 1 mL of fresh MEBM mammosphere medium.
Pipette cell culture medium with mammospheres from 6-well plates.
Pass the mixture through a 30 μm filcon steril cup in a 50 mL conical tube.
Place the filcon steril cup type at the top of a new 50 mL conical tube and turn it upside down.
Plug a 10 mL syringe filled with DPBS (1X) and flush the mammosphere-containing medium through the filter to retain the mammospheres.
Centrifuge the 50 mL conical tubes at 100 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate completely the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add 2–3 mL of pre-warmed trypsin-EDTA (0.05%) to the pellet and incubate at 37°C in a 2D orbital Incu-shaker for 2–3 minutes.
Pour the digested mammosphere solution through a cell strainer (40 μm) placed at the top of a new 50 mL conical tube.
Rinse the cell strainer with 5 mL of DPBS (1X)-5% FBS.
Proceed to cell counting using Malassez counting chamber.
Centrifuge 50 mL conical tubes at 100 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate completely the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in DPBS (1X) with 5% FBS and viability dye diluted 1:1,000 to a final concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Transfer cell suspension into 5 mL FACS tube (4 mL maximum volume per tube).
Incubate the samples for 10 minutes at 4°C in the dark.
Centrifuge 5 mL FACS tubes at 100 g for 5 minutes at room temperature.
Aspirate completely the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Resuspend the pellet in DPBS (1X) with 5% FBS to obtain a final concentration of 10 × 10^6 cells/mL.
